tool.name: HOOMD-blue
tool.source: https://hoomd-blue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ (units, md.bond.Harmonic, md.methods.Brownian, md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities), read on the days their material cards name; the release they document is a row of values_read
tool.language: Python package over a C++ core
tool.version: conda-forge's hoomd for osx-arm64 at the version values_read names, the one the adapters were tried on
tool.license: BSD-3-Clause, as conda-forge states it for hoomd

claims.claim: HOOMD-blue adopts no system of units: it follows a self-consistent one on three base units, energy, length and mass, from which time, force and pressure are derived

evidence.locus: Units, sections Base Units and Unit Conversion (mat-20261120-hoomd-7.2.2-units)

claims.claim: md.bond.Harmonic gives each bond the energy U(r) = k (r - r0)^2 / 2, with k the potential constant in energy per length squared and r0 the rest length, set per bond type in params

md.methods.Brownian integrates the overdamped Langevin equation on a particle filter at a temperature kT (energy) with a translational drag coefficient gamma per particle type (mass per time), the random force sized by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem; its error is first order in the time step

evidence.locus: hoomd.md.methods.Brownian, the equations of motion, the parameters and the warning (mat-20261121-hoomd-7.2.2-methods-brownian)

claims.limitations: no hydrodynamic interaction between particles is stated, and none is in the dumbbell model either

claims.claim: md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities reports pressure_tensor, six components xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz, each the kinetic sum plus the net virial of the integrator's forces over the volume, in pressure units; under Brownian the velocities are drawn each step at the set temperature
claims.limitations: a pressure is positive in compression: a stress read from it carries the opposite sign

claims.claim: HOOMD-blue computes the virial and the pressure only on steps where a GSD writer or an NPT integrator needs them unless Simulation.always_compute_pressure is set; read between them, pressure_tensor is not a number

evidence.locus: the run adapter's first trial under TMPDIR, every logged component not a number, and its second, finite with the flag set (failure bd-1)

claims.claim: the run adapter, tried under TMPDIR with hoomd from conda-forge, ran Brownian dynamics of Hookean dumbbells and logged the xy, xz and yz components of the pressure tensor with the box volume; passed through autocorrelation_of_series, shear_relaxation_modulus_green_kubo and exponential_decay_fit they gave a relaxation time and a viscosity near the dumbbell relations' for the trial's settings (evidence for the adapter only; no value of it enters a card)

evidence.locus: the adapter's third trial under TMPDIR, result.json and run.log of its run folder

claims.limitations: the first trial, a tenth as long, gave a decay time well off the relation's: how long a run must be for a given precision is not settled, and the uncertainty of the Green-Kubo estimate is not yet computed by any skill
